task: Implement the global lifecycle control plane so Proofbound hosts can inspect runtime closure, proof-consumption closure, queue governance, dashboard state, and named guardrails from mechanical CLI output.
outcome: After the story is done, an operator can run lattice global_control_status --format=json and see story rows with authoritativeCwd, runtime status, consumption status, queue classification, nextSafeAction, Tier-C experiment grouping, duplicate cleanup suggestions, and explicit local-only proof boundaries; the operator can also run lattice admissibility_waterline --storyId=<id> --format=json to inspect consumer buckets and reasons without stitching session_brief, story_authority_resolve, lifecycle_check, and stale plan docs.
facts: B-376c completed schema and milestone alignment only; it deliberately did not implement full CP-0 through CP-5 behavior.

Command registration must touch command-catalog.ts, registry.ts, command-policy.ts, config.ts phase tools, activity-policy.ts for read-only commands, process-fact-levels.ts, and cli-engine text markers.
Runtime projection should consume resolveStoryAuthority, buildStoryReadinessReport, summarizeOwnerLease, and existing freshness/stale-hint helpers rather than inventing new classifiers.
Proof Admissibility Appendix D defines the minimum admissibility_waterline output; B-eb18 includes that minimum because the user requested the whole plan completed.
queue_exception_set is a guarded write, not read-only; queue status commands are read-only and queue exception writes need audit metadata and write coordination.
INIT and scope reviewers require explicit product-visible completion, strict non-replacement of lifecycle/proof/Authority semantics, expanded experiment view, and explicit exception registry schema.
constraints: Do not create a second lifecycle state machine or bypass story_advance gates.
Do not reimplement Proof Admissibility policy, evidence freshness classification, DONE oracle, or Evidence Runtime verification.
Do not optimize arbitrarily; only implement the real correctness and consistency gaps named by the execution plan.
Keep Authority/production semantics out of the control plane; render lower-layer results only.
Queue exceptions must preserve Tier-C experiment evidence and must not hide malformed or cleanup-required stories.
All user-facing CLI output must separate story-level blockers from project-level queue health.
